outputs.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution localization images, a Voronoi density map, and cluster segmentation renderings of CtpG-mEos; these are micrograph/heatmap-type visualizations, not summary plots of averaged data, so the individual-points check does not apply.
Same as panel A but for PacL2-mEos; localization/density/cluster images, not an averaged summary plot.
Scatter/dot plot of number of clusters per cell showing mean ± SEM with individual cell values plotted as gray dots, as stated in the caption and visible in the figure.
Scatter/dot plot of cluster size showing mean ± SEM with individual cluster values plotted as gray dots.
Scatter/dot plot of percentage of molecules in clusters showing mean ± SEM with individual cell values plotted as gray dots.
Panel F shows super-resolution localization and trajectory images (micrographs), not a summary plot of averaged data.

Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients (already displaying the full distribution of raw measurements, not an average), and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement across individual trajectories; both plot types are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph, which are visualizations of individual molecule tracks rather than an averaged summary plot.
